english.title: Offer to sell personal data - data protection
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without the consent of the data controller, offered for sale personal data which you

(A)_[knowingly or recklessly obtained]_
(B)_[subsequently knowingly or recklessly obtained]_
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 55(5) and 60(2) of the Data Protection Act 1998.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
without the consent of the data controller offered for sale personal data
knowingly / recklessly obtained / subsequently knowingly / recklessly obtained

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
For the current legislation, please see section 170 of Data Protection Act 2018.
(i) Prosecution only by Commissioner or with the consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions
(ii) See Part IV of the Act for exemptions
(iii) See section 55(2) for exceptions
(iv) For the purposes of this offence Section 1(2) of the Act does not apply
(v) For the purposes of this offence, an advertisement indicating that personal data are or may be for sale is an offer to sell the data
(vi) For the purposes of this offence, "personal data" includes information extracted from personal data.
(vi) For the purposes of this offence references to personal data do not include references to personal data which by virtue of section 28 are exempt from this Section.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: A fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
